title: Tegaki turns any Google Font into animated handwriting
description:
Animated handwriting effects on landing pages usually mean hours of manually tracing SVG paths in Illustrator. Tegaki automates the entire process. Give it any Google Font and it generates a perfectly animated real-time handwriting effect. The creator wrote a complete image processing pipeline including custom rasterization, and distance transforms,  Single NPM package, React components included.

https://github.com/KurtGokhan/tegaki

#github #opensource
